_note: Hand-curated, vendored subset of n8n's core node catalog -- not mechanically generated. n8n's full node catalog only exists as TypeScript source (packages/nodes-base/**/*.node.ts) with no downloadable JSON, and its public REST API has no node-schema endpoint (both confirmed live against n8n's own docs/community forum). Each entry's `type`/`type_version`/parameter shape was checked against n8n's published docs at https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/core-nodes/ -- spot-check against a real running instance before first production import, since n8n does version these independently over time.

deferred_cluster_nodes._note: Real, verified n8n node data that deliberately is NOT in the `nodes` array above, and must not be moved there until backend/render/node_mapper.py's one-atomic-step-to-one-standalone-node model can represent a cluster/parent-child node structure. match_schema() iterates `nodes` directly by keyword; an entry here that got moved into `nodes` today would match real atomic steps (e.g. 'embed_chunks') and silently emit an orphaned sub-node with no parent Vector Store node, producing a workflow JSON that looks valid but fails to import cleanly -- exactly the R14/NT2 defect this file exists to prevent. Steps that would otherwise match these keywords correctly fall back to the Code node (NT3) until the Node Mapper supports cluster nodes.
